exactConstraint: C9WorkReceipt_time_ck requires admittedAt < retentionUntil, startedAt absent or >= admittedAt, settledAt absent or >= admittedAt. It does not separately compare settledAt against startedAt.

sourceTrace.observation: Every C9 transaction reads current principal, then SELECT clock_timestamp() now, then passes that Date to the work callback.
reserve stores admittedAt from its own transaction clock.
claim stores startedAt from a later transaction clock.
settle stores settledAt from its transaction clock, not selection.asOf or usage.verifiedAt.
The affected path awaits reserve, then claim, then selection/context/revision, and finally settlement. No overlapping invocation accounts for earlier settlement sampling here.
UTC wrapper only sets the transaction timezone and isolation/timeout options; it does not replace database or process time.
The existing CHECK rejected the actual attempted row; it was not weakened for this proof.

inference: The sequential real DB clock samples, plus the PostgreSQL error-log wall timestamp before the persisted startedAt, support a backwards wall-clock observation in this run.
No timestamp-assignment change is present in the reviewed C8 request/filter delta. The probe and setup do not inject a fake clock or backdate these receipt fields.
This is not proof of a particular host/NTP/time-sync mechanism, nor a complete exclusion of all timestamp-stack defects. No historical monotonic-versus-wall-clock telemetry was recorded.
The database refused settlement. R1 is an actual failed/incomplete proof, not a passing test, accepted refusal scenario, or complete end-to-end qualification.
retryQualification: One new isolated proof attempt on identical committed source can provide another observation. Preserve R1 unchanged as FAIL. Repeated inversion should stop the proof and trigger focused diagnosis; do not clamp timestamps, rewrite constraints, add unbounded retries or reuse the failed receipt.
currentClockSamplingQualification: The parent reported a later finite OS clock sample with no backwards observation. That sample cannot establish or refute the historical cause of R1. No clock sampling was performed by this reviewer.

separation.r2: Running separately at request time; not read, graded or incorporated in this diagnosis.
separation.privateData: No private restart receipt, credentials or terminal input read. Raw log hashes bind evidence without copying failing-row identifiers or lease material into this report.
